import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    p=params
    s=1/(1+P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3+p[4]*s+p[5]*s**2
            +t*(p[6]+p[7]*P+p[8]*s)
            +t**2*(p[9]+0*P))
